data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to retrieve system proxy settings for Dart HttpClient.
data.what_it_does: Retrieves the device's system proxy settings so you can configure Dart's HttpClient to route traffic through a proxy. This makes it easier to inspect and grab HTTP requests for testing.
use_when: You need to grab and test Dart HttpClient requests using a network proxy tool
You want to automatically adapt to system proxy settings on Android and iOS
avoid_when: You are not using Dart's HttpClient or need a completely custom proxy solution without system lookup
strengths: Solves the specific problem of Dart HttpClient ignoring system proxy settings by default
Simple API to get host and port settings
weaknesses: Basic features with no extensive configuration options documented
